beats: Every new app the boys installed quietly counted as free TV time.
The old rule only gated apps I already knew; anything unfamiliar defaulted to free.
Like a guard who only recognizes faces he's already met.
So I flipped it: only three plain apps stay free, everything else now needs the bonus.
I applied that rule across every device, so it lives identically in four places now — and can't quietly go stale.
